items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: All they got, they got fellas in the Eureka. ... Sonny Henry, he must know cause he was in the Eureka. Years ago.

ctx.x: Whose place? Yes. Oh he take my... Whose place did he take? Let's see what place did he have. Whose place did he take? What place did he take? What place did he take? New Rodriguez I've been here. Yeah he took me to the band. That's where the Eureka? That's Eureka yeah.
Well how did the Eureka get his name? How did you ever get that name for it?

I don't know I'm the one giving it. Yes. I listen. They had some... I used to bum in a yard down there. And they had some watched indie boys you know? Yes. And they all, they were musicians. But they didn't let, I didn't let them know I could play you know? So I used to, they used to make a drink every, every, they'd get paid every Tuesday. And they'd come in and smoke. They'd make a nice drink with it. So on Saturday I said well Saturday my payday I won't make a drink. Buy the stuff too. No, of course they…
